metadata.title: Mongera et al. (2018) Nature & Kim et al. (2021) Nature Physics — Active Fluid-to-Solid Jamming Transition, Extracellular Space Compaction, Ferrofluid Yield-Stress Gradient & Unidirectional Vertebrate Body Axis Elongation in Zebrafish
metadata.organism: Danio rerio (zebrafish 10-somite stage posterior tailbud: Mesodermal Progenitor Zone MPZ, Posterior Presomitic Mesoderm P-PSM, and Anterior Presomitic Mesoderm A-PSM)

sources.citation: Mongera A, Rowghanian P, Gustafson HJ, Shelton E, Kealhofer DA, Carn EK, Serwane F, Lucio AA, Giammona J, Campas O (2018). A fluid-to-solid jamming transition underlies vertebrate body axis elongation. Nature 561(7723):401-405.
Kim S, Pochitaloff M, Stooke-Vaughan GA, Campas O (2021). Embryonic tissues as active foams. Nature Physics 17(7):859-866.
Lawton AK, Nandi A, Stulberg MJ, Dray N, Sneddon MW, Emonet T, Blawzdziewicz J, Holley SA (2013). Regulated tissue fluidity steers zebrafish body elongation. Development 140(3):573-582.

Serwane F, Mongera A, Rowghanian P, Kealhofer DA, Lucio AA, Hockenbery ZM, Campas O (2017). In vivo quantification of spatially varying mechanical properties in developing tissues. Nature Methods 14(2):181-186.
Dray N, Lawton A, Nandi A, Julicher F, Emonet T, Holley SA (2013). Cell-fibronectin interactions propel vertebrate trunk elongation via tissue mechanics. Current Biology 23(14):1335-1341.

zebrafish_tailbud_psm_specimen.species: Danio rerio (zebrafish embryo posterior tailbud lightsheet nuclear fluorescence micrograph showing the rounded posterior Mesodermal Progenitor Zone MPZ on the left, bilateral Presomitic Mesoderm PSM bands, and central rod-like notochord; Open Microscopy Image Data Resource study idr0051 / Dray & Lawton et al. 2013)

mongera_2018_kim_2021_governing_equation.section: Mongera et al. (2018) Nature 561:401-405 Figs. 1-4 & Methods; Kim et al. (2021) Nature Physics 17:859-866 Eqs. 1-6
mongera_2018_kim_2021_governing_equation.rigidity_percolation_yield_stress_law: sigma_y(x) = sigma_0 * max(0, phi_pack(x) - phi_c)^beta = sigma_0 * max(0, phi_ECS_crit - phi_ECS(x))^beta
mongera_2018_kim_2021_governing_equation.isostatic_coordination_relation: z(x) = z_c + z_slope * (phi_pack(x) - phi_c),  with z_c = 4.0 (2D) / 6.0 (3D)
mongera_2018_kim_2021_governing_equation.unidirectional_posterior_elongation_flux: v_posterior = J_mpz * (sigma_y_APSM / (sigma_y_APSM + sigma_y_MPZ + sigma_ref)),  where solid A-PSM (sigma_y_APSM >> sigma_y_MPZ) acts as a mechanical backstop rectifying MPZ mass addition posteriorly

canonical_parameters.species: Danio rerio (10-somite stage embryo at 28.5 C)

ap_axis_spatial_profile_mongera_2018.section: Mongera et al. (2018) Nature 561:401-405 Figs. 1c-f, 2c-f, 3b-f (Posterior-to-Anterior Profile from Tailbud Tip x=0 um to A-PSM x=300 um)

experimental_perturbation_regimes.section: Mongera et al. (2018) Nature 561:401-405 Fig. 4 & Extended Data Figs. 5-8; Lawton et al. (2013) Development 140:573-582

regimes.label: Wild-type Danio rerio (graded ECS compaction 14.5% -> 4.9%, solid A-PSM backstop)
cdh2 (N-cadherin) morphant / parachute mutant (expanded ECS 21% -> 14.8%, collapsed PSM yield stress & bilateral asymmetry)
Blebbistatin Myosin-II inhibition (suppressed active fluctuations sigma_A, arrested MPZ T1 fluidity)
SU5402 FGFR inhibition (reduced posterior MPZ motility & premature posterior compaction)
Zero-Backstop Ablation Control (uniformly unjammed phi_ECS = 0.165 > phi_ECS_crit everywhere, sigma_y = 0)

fibronectin_sheath_governing_equations.section: Pass 3 reduced quasi-3D (thin-rod, axisymmetric) fibronectin ECM sheath model after Dray et al. (2013) Current Biology 23:1335-1341 Figs. 1-4 and Lawton et al. (2013) Development 140:573-582; NOT a 3D finite-element or Stokes solve
fibronectin_sheath_governing_equations.fibronectin_density_profile: f_FN(x) = fn_scale * [F_MPZ + (F_PSM - F_MPZ) * sigmoid((x - 110 um)/40 um) + Delta_f_somite * H(x - x_arrest)]
fibronectin_sheath_governing_equations.sheath_hoop_equilibrium: eps_r(x) = max(0, sigma_A(x) - sigma_y(x)) / (K_FN * f_FN(x) + K_t);  R_eq(x) = R_0(x) * (1 + eps_r(x))
fibronectin_sheath_governing_equations.axial_channeling_efficiency: chi = 1 - < 1 - A_0/A_eq >_w over the fluid zone x <= x_jam with influx weight w(x) = exp(-x / L_src);  v_elong = J_MPZ * backstop * fluidity * chi
fibronectin_sheath_governing_equations.dynamic_wall_friction_diagnostic: F_drag = integral_0^{x_jam} 2 pi R_0(x) zeta_FN f_FN(x) v_rel(x) dx  (reported, not fed back)

canonical_parameters.calibration_note: K_FN and K_t are calibrated so that the WT tip hoop strain is ~4% and the fn1a/fn1b double-morphant speed ratio approaches the approximate Dray et al. (2013) value; they are not independently measured sheath moduli.

dray_2013_fibronectin_regimes.section: Dray et al. (2013) Current Biology 23:1335-1341 Figs. 2-4 (fn1a/fn1b double morphants, itga5 morphants) — APPROXIMATE ratios digitised from the published bar charts / text; treat as order-of-magnitude anchors with the stated uncertainty

regimes.label: itga5 (integrin alpha5) morphant — partial loss of cell-fibronectin adhesion (fn_scale = 0.45)
fn1a;fn1b double morphant — near-complete loss of fibronectin matrix (fn_scale = 0.12)

segmentation_clock_wavefront_reference.section: Her1/Her7 segmentation clock and wavefront arrest coupled to the jamming gradient (Oates & Ho 2002; Lewis 2003 Curr Biol 13:1398; Herrgen et al. 2010 Curr Biol 20:1244; Soroldoni et al. 2014 Science 345:222; Hubaud et al. 2017 Cell 171:668)
segmentation_clock_wavefront_reference.clock_phase_advection_law: d theta/dt + u(x) d theta/dx = omega(x),  theta(0,t) = omega_0 t,  omega(x) = omega_0 [1 - c_slow (x/x_arrest)^2] for x < x_arrest and 0 anterior (arrest)
segmentation_clock_wavefront_reference.mechanical_arrest_gate: x_arrest = min{ x : sigma_y(x)/sigma_A(x) >= Lambda_arrest },  Lambda_arrest = 4 (deep solid; x_jam < x_arrest)
segmentation_clock_wavefront_reference.cooke_zeeman_somite_length: S = v_front * T_clock,  v_front = v_elong + v_PSM_shortening

canonical_parameters.clock_period_source: Herrgen et al. (2010) wild-type somitogenesis period at 28 C (Schroter et al. 2008 Dev Dyn 237:545 report 23-24 min); Lewis (2003) used ~30 min
canonical_parameters.v_psm_shortening_note: approximate: PSM shortens by ~210 um over ~20 somite cycles (Soroldoni et al. 2014 Fig. 1), 210 / (20 * 23.5 min)
canonical_parameters.somite_length_note: approximate trunk somite AP length at the 10-15 somite stage, 28 C (45-50 um range)
canonical_parameters.arrest_front_note: P-PSM/A-PSM boundary of the Mongera et al. (2018) profile (x = 180 um, sigma_y/sigma_A = 4.7) taken as the approximate position where the tissue is fully solid and the determination front lies
